panels.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate(nutsnews_worker_uplift_stage_latency_seconds_bucket{environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service) (sum by (service) (rate(nutsnews_worker_uplift_stage_latency_seconds_count{environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or on(service) (((0 * max by (service) (nutsnews_worker_uplift_stage_latency_seconds_count{environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service"})) - 1) unless on(service) (sum by (service) (rate(nutsnews_worker_uplift_stage_latency_seconds_count{environment=~"$environment",service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))

panels.title: Retry And DLQ Budget Ratio
